coverage: Grades are worked out in your browser from the daily closing prices on record for the 1,833 stocks in the daily scoring run, 404 trading days from 2025-03-25 to 2026-10-30. Stocks that stopped trading earlier are not in that run and are not on record here.

explanation.body: Its current reading is from 2026-10-30. Nothing from the record on file is missing. The next update arrives at the next session close on this page's normal schedule.
explanation.summary: Type in a call you made (a stock, whether you said it would go up or down, and the date you called it) and see what the price actually did 1, 5 and 21 trading days later, graded the same way this site grades its own calls.

method.horizons: The grade is read at 1, 5 and 21 trading days after the starting close, counted in the stock's own trading days: the price then, the percent move from the starting price, and whether your call was right at that point.
method.not_yet: If a grading point has not happened yet in the price history on record, the result says not gradable yet and shows the date it becomes gradable. Nothing is estimated.
method.outside: A call dated before the first day on record or after the last day on record cannot be graded from this history, and the result says so.
method.right: A call that the price would go up is right only when the price is higher at the grading point. A call that it would go down is right only when the price is lower. An unchanged price makes neither call right.
method.start: Your call is graded from the stock's closing price on the date you called it. If that date was not a trading day for the stock, the next closing price it has is the starting price, and your result says so.

missing.what_and_when: Nothing from the record on file is missing. The next update arrives at the next session close on this page's normal schedule.

subject_charts.label: The closing price history this page grades calls from, session by session. It is both the reading and the record.
